description: Survey aggregates that passed the Curb Cut disclosure gate (packages/ingest/src/curbcut_ingest/disclosure.py).
disclosure_rule: Cells with fewer than 30 unweighted respondents in the denominator are suppressed: estimate, se, interval, n_effective and df are null and suppressed = true.

dhs2024_national.csv.citation: National Population Commission (NPC) [Nigeria] and ICF. Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey 2024. Abuja, Nigeria, and Rockville, Maryland, USA: NPC and ICF.
dhs2024_national.csv.design: De facto household members aged 5+ asked the WG-SS (hdis2-hdis8; 8 = don't know -> missing). Weight hv005/1e6, strata hv023, PSU hv021.
dhs2024_national.csv.terms: DHS Program terms: registered project only ('Curb Cut: disability prevalence and poverty in Nigeria'); aggregates only, no microdata; a PDF of every publication goes to references@dhsprogram.com.

dhs2024_state.csv.citation: National Population Commission (NPC) [Nigeria] and ICF. Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey 2024. Abuja, Nigeria, and Rockville, Maryland, USA: NPC and ICF.
dhs2024_state.csv.design: De facto household members aged 5+ asked the WG-SS (hdis2-hdis8; 8 = don't know -> missing). Weight hv005/1e6, strata hv023, PSU hv021.
dhs2024_state.csv.terms: DHS Program terms: registered project only ('Curb Cut: disability prevalence and poverty in Nigeria'); aggregates only, no microdata; a PDF of every publication goes to references@dhsprogram.com.

ghs_w4_national_zone.csv.citation: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS), Nigeria. General Household Survey, Panel 2018-2019, Wave 4 (NGA_2018_GHSP-W4_v03_M). World Bank Microdata Library.
ghs_w4_national_zone.csv.design: Post-harvest sect4a, WG-SS s4aq23-s4aq33 (-1 too young -> missing), members 5+. Weight wt_wave4 (cross-section), strata 'strata', PSU 'cluster'. National and zone only (not representative by state).
ghs_w4_national_zone.csv.terms: World Bank Microdata Library public-use terms: aggregates only, cite the dataset.

ghs_w5_national_zone.csv.citation: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS), Nigeria. General Household Survey, Panel 2023-2024, Wave 5 (NGA_2023_GHSP-W5_v02_M). World Bank Microdata Library.
ghs_w5_national_zone.csv.design: Post-planting sect3, WG-SS s3q23-s3q28, members 5+. Weight wt_cross_wave5 (cross-section), strata 'strata', PSU 'cluster'. National and zone only.
ghs_w5_national_zone.csv.terms: World Bank Microdata Library public-use terms: aggregates only, cite the dataset.

mpi2021/mpi2021_state_national.csv.reason: Held until NBS replies about publishing aggregates and the P4 gate (docs/STATUS.md); produced and checked locally only.

interval: 95% Korn-Graubard (Clopper-Pearson with effective n and design df).
precision_standard: NCHS Data Presentation Standards for Proportions (Parker et al. 2017, Vital Health Stat 2(175)); see docs/verification.md D42.
